name: Flowith
tagline: Agentic AI workspace on an infinite canvas with autonomous multi-task agents.
description: Flowith is an AI workspace built around an infinite two-dimensional canvas, where you branch threads and organize work visually instead of in a linear chat. Its autonomous agent, NEO, plans and executes multi-step tasks with tool calling and persistent context, while the Oracle scheduler breaks complex jobs into subtasks. It supports leading models including GPT and Claude. A free Starter tier offers limited credits, with paid Professional, Ultimate, and Infinite plans.
insight: Founded in 2023 in Shanghai by Yichen Wu and Derek Nee; a Y Combinator-backed startup.

modelSupport.notes: Supports models incl. OpenAI GPT and Anthropic Claude.

edge: Its NEO agent executes many tasks in parallel across a branching workspace, instead of one linear chat thread.

references.title: Flowith Review 2026: Overhyped or Worth It?
